name: Inspect a selected graph entity
description: Verifies a user can select an entity and inspect its identifier, plane and attached evidence.
steps: Select the termux-monorepo entity in the outline
Inspect the details panel and connected evidence
expected: The inspector shows termux-monorepo, its GitHub plane and the connected evidence records.

name: Search and filter the graph
description: Verifies search and filters narrow the graph without corrupting the source fixture.
steps: Enter data-visualization in the graph search field
Choose GitHub in the plane filter
Clear the search and choose an unmatched query
expected: Matching entities remain visible for the search and an explanatory empty state appears for an unmatched query.

name: Switch views and restore a shareable state
description: Verifies view switching and selected-entity state are reflected in the browser URL.
steps: Choose Network in the view switcher
Verify the URL contains view=network and the selected node identifier
Open the saved URL in a fresh page or reload the current page
Verify Network view and the studysprint selection are restored
expected: Reopening the saved URL restores Network view and the studysprint selection; the evidence ledger then displays relationship records.

name: Keep keyboard navigation and filter recovery usable on mobile
description: Verifies mobile users can reach entity controls and recover from an empty filter state.
steps: Search for an entity name that does not exist
Use Tab to reach an entity and press Enter
expected: The graph returns to its default view and a keyboard-selected entity can be inspected.
